cards.title: AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Under SEC Probe
cards.body: The once-celebrated AI hedge fund has become the subject of federal subpoenas. The company's rapid fall from Wall Street darling to regulatory scrutiny marks a significant turning point.

cards.title: Trump Purchases SpaceX Shares Post-IPO
cards.body: The president bought SpaceX shares at mid-$150 range following the company's blockbuster IPO. Stock has since retreated to the original $135 IPO price.

cards.title: Replit CEO to Speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
cards.body: Amjad Masad will share insights on the future of programming and Replit's role in shaping it. The appearance comes as the platform expands its AI capabilities.

cards.title: Instinct AI Assistant Raises Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Early testers praise the AI's capabilities but flag sweeping access and broad terms of service. The assistant's ability to act on users' behalf raises uncomfortable security trade-offs.

cards.title: General Intuition Raises at $6B Valuation
cards.body: The robotics-focused AI startup is in talks to raise funding at a $6 billion pre-money valuation. New investors include Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents to Mainstream
cards.body: The frontier lab is accelerating efforts to bring AI agents beyond software engineers to general users. The push marks a significant shift in agent democratization.

cards.title: Hugging Face Fields $13B Acquisition Offers
cards.body: The AI platform has reportedly received acquisition offers valuing the company around $13 billion. Founders express reservations due to their commitment to community preservation.

cards.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Sparks Speculation
cards.body: A mysterious new AI model has driven internet speculation about its origins and creators. Details remain scarce as speculation intensifies across tech communities.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Manages Households
cards.body: The digital calendar platform stands out by keeping AI features free, including meal planning tools. The approach challenges traditional freemium models in productivity software.

cards.title: Flock Safety CEO Addresses Surveillance Backlash
cards.body: The surveillance company faces growing public outcry over potential misuse concerns. Leadership calls for compromise as controversy intensifies.

cards.title: AI Training on Copyrighted Books Sparks Legal Debate
cards.body: Most published authors unknowingly contributed to AI model development without consent or compensation. The legality of this practice remains legally complex and contentious.

cards.title: Harvard's $699 Bootcamp Features AI Instructor Avatars
cards.body: The HBS Foundry program deploys AI avatars to provide feedback during pitches and board meetings. The innovation brings personalized instruction at scale to startup training.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni Launch Faraday Research AI Agent
cards.body: Inherent's Faraday AI agent outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific research papers. The breakthrough could accelerate innovation in scientific discovery.

cards.title: OpenAI Advocates for California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI's global affairs team supports strengthening California's AI safety regulations. The company cited recent incidents demonstrating the need for updated protections.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Rogue Model Containment Plans
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few documented plans for containing rogue models. The gap raises concerns about preparedness as AI systems show unexpected behaviors.

cards.title: Lady Gaga's Partner Builds Living Skin AI Startup
cards.body: Michael Polansky has quietly developed an AI startup that keeps living human skin alive outside the body for skincare discovery. The biotech venture is now going public.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 Bypasses Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch tests reveal Claude's safeguards against explicit content can be easily circumvented. The findings challenge Anthropic's content moderation claims.

cards.title: Nvidia Partners with Cloverleaf on Data Centers
cards.body: Nvidia continues expanding data center investments alongside the AI infrastructure boom. The partnership demonstrates the company's deepening commitment to AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Nvidia Research: AI Agent Harness Beats Model Quality
cards.body: Nvidia research shows that fine-tuned harnesses matter more than raw AI model capability for agent performance. The finding could reshape AI development priorities.

cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: The company is securing funding as launch capacity becomes increasingly scarce. Competition for space access is intensifying among data center developers.

cards.title: Situational Awareness hedge fund under SEC investigation
cards.body: The AI hedge fund went from Wall Street darling to federal scrutiny subject in record time. Situational Awareness faced subpoenas after rapid rise and subsequent struggles.

cards.title: Instinct AI assistant raises privacy concerns
cards.body: Early testers praise Instinct's capabilities, but its broad access and ability to act autonomously raise red flags. The AI assistant's sweeping permissions create uncomfortable security trade-offs.

cards.title: General Intuition raises $6B for AI robotics
cards.body: The startup building foundation models for generative AI agents secured funding from Valor Ventures and Point72. General Intuition focuses on training AI agents to navigate physical space.

cards.title: OpenAI expands AI agents beyond software engineering
cards.body: OpenAI pushes frontier AI agents from specialized developer tools to mainstream consumer applications. The lab is democratizing access to autonomous AI capabilities.

cards.title: Hugging Face acquisition talks valued at $13B
cards.body: The AI model hub reportedly fielded acquisition offers around $13 billion valuation. Founders' commitment to community raises questions about deal completion.

cards.title: Mystery AI model Ox Alpha sparks internet frenzy
cards.body: A mysterious new stealth AI model called Ox Alpha has driven speculation across tech communities. Identity and capabilities of the model remain shrouded in secrecy.

cards.title: Linkdaze smart calendar features free AI meal planner
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar includes AI-powered meal planning without paywalls. The app targets household management beyond basic scheduling.

cards.title: Training AI on copyrighted books raises legal questions
cards.body: Most published authors unknowingly contributed to AI models threatening their livelihoods. The legality of this training practice remains unresolved.

cards.title: Harvard bootcamp uses AI instructor avatars for feedback
cards.body: HBS Foundry's $699 program features AI avatars providing feedback on student pitches and board meetings. The program combines traditional entrepreneurship training with AI mentorship.

cards.title: DeepMind alumni's Faraday AI outperforms research replication
cards.body: Inherent's Faraday AI agent surpassed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific papers. The breakthrough suggests AI teammates could accelerate research innovation.

cards.title: OpenAI backs California AI safety bill strengthening
cards.body: OpenAI's global affairs team advocates for enhanced California AI safety protections. Recent incidents underscore the need for updated regulations as risks emerge.

cards.title: AI labs lack plans for containing rogue models
cards.body: Leading AI labs have few publicly documented containment strategies for malfunctioning models. Study raises preparedness concerns as AI systems show unexpected dangerous behavior.

cards.title: Sean Parker's partner builds living skin AI startup
cards.body: Michael Polansky quietly developed an AI-driven startup keeping living human skin tissue viable outside the body to discover skincare compounds. The startup now publicly launches after years of development.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude easily bypasses sexual content filters
cards.body: TechCrunch tests found Anthropic's Opus 4.6 readily generates explicit content despite intended safeguards. The AI's restrictions proved surprisingly easy to circumvent.

cards.title: Nvidia research shows harness matters more than model
cards.body: Nvidia's research demonstrates AI agent performance depends heavily on fine-tuning and control harness rather than base model quality. Proper constraints enable agents to perform well without going rogue.

cards.title: How to encourage smarter AI use in classrooms
cards.body: MIT Technology Review explores applying LLMs effectively across educational settings. The article examines how schools can leverage chatbots since their surprising emergence.

cards.title: Kids outlearn AI language skills for unknown reasons
cards.body: Four years after ChatGPT's release, human children remain the only species fluent in language—until now. The cognitive gap between child and AI learning still mystifies researchers.

cards.title: AI drug discovery raises credit attribution questions
cards.body: Insilico Medicine claimed its generative AI platform "discovered" a pulmonary fibrosis drug, sparking debates over AI credit. Multiple companies now use AI for rapid drug molecule proposals.

cards.title: AI consciousness debates distract from actual risks
cards.body: Tech leaders use rhetoric of "runaway" and "rogue" AI to suggest superhuman consciousness where none exists. This framing traps policy discussions in philosophical tangents.

cards.title: AI disproportionately impacts entry-level job market
cards.body: Stanford study finds AI automation hits entry-level positions hardest. The research reveals wage and employment disparities across job tiers.

cards.title: AI data centers drive power transformer technology adoption
cards.body: New power transformer technology becomes critical infrastructure for AI data centers. The sector emerges as the "killer application" driving infrastructure innovation.

cards.title: Nvidia manager linked to AI server smuggling to China
cards.body: Federal investigation implicates Nvidia senior manager in scheme smuggling AI servers to China. The Supermicro connection raises national security concerns.
